name: Ernst Lautenschlager
bio: A Stuttgart privateer who shared Porsche 550 Spyder chassis 550-0033 with Rudi Scholl in the 1955 Mille Miglia as entry 548, finishing twenty-third overall and third in the 1500 Sport class after nearly thirteen hours on the road — of the 534 cars that started, 281 got home. He also hillclimbed a Stanguellini at Schauinsland.
